name: InterContinental Minneapolis – St Paul Airport
insider_take: This sleek airport hotel puts you at the crossroads of two iconic Twin Cities, with sophisticated amenities that rival downtown luxury properties.
whats_special: The InterContinental Minneapolis – St Paul Airport sits uniquely between two major cities, offering stunning views of the Minneapolis skyline. The hotel features contemporary Scandinavian-inspired design reflecting the region's Nordic heritage, plus an impressive art collection showcasing local Minnesota artists. The property's restaurant serves locally-sourced ingredients from Minnesota farms and the famous Boundary Waters region.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing northwest for breathtaking sunset views over the Minneapolis downtown skyline – it's especially spectacular during winter when the city lights reflect off the snow.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Fort Snelling State Park offers unexpected nature access just minutes from MSP Airport. Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to explore the confluence of the Mississippi and Minnesota Rivers, or visit the historic Fort Snelling, which played a crucial role in westward expansion and offers panoramic views of both Twin Cities.
pros: Prime airport location with convenient terminal access
Luxury InterContinental brand amenities and service standards
Modern facilities ideal for business travelers
IHG Destined Program exclusive benefits and recognition
cons: Airport location may limit local dining and entertainment options
Potential aircraft noise due to proximity to runways
